title: Writing / Glossary
slide_intent: Use shared definitions so different writers explain the same product consistently to learners and the wider public.
strategic_value: A common terminology reference can help Duolingo reduce contradictory explanations of its offer.
demonstration: The blue glossary introduction pairs a consistency statement with a tall stack of brightly colored books.
practical_value: Check the agreed definition and preferred term before describing a product concept.

content_islands.name: Section introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the Writing label, lowercase section title and explanatory paragraph at left on the blue field.

content_islands.name: Illustrated cue
content_islands.spec: Place a colorful stack of books at right, rising nearly the full height of the header.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph explicitly connects consistent messaging with understanding what Duolingo is and how it works.
